Rumiko Takahashi

I have read literally every single work by Rumiko Takahashi, a very famous mangaka and one of the wealthiest women in Japan. Takahashi's manga are all slow-burn romantic comedies, ranging from sci-fi slapstick to martial arts slapstick to epic fantasy (slapstick). I have not watched all the anime adaptions yet, but will probably do so one day.

  1. Urusei Yatsura (I've also watched the original anime series and the first two movies)
  2. Ranma 1/2 (ongoing anime on Netflix)
  3. Maison Ikkoku
  4. Inuyasha
  5. Rin-ne
  6. Mao (ongoing manga and anime)
